name: Progeni Bench
shortDescription: Progeni Bench brings together browser tools for images, audio, files, data, crafts and productivity. Most tools process files locally; PDF Translator sends extracted text to DeepL.
description: Progeni Bench is a browser-based collection of utilities for image, audio, file, data, craft and productivity tasks. It includes Avery label makers, sticker sheets, image resizing and conversion, audio editing and analysis, subtitle timing repair, CSV and vCard cleaning, QR and barcode generators, SVG optimisation and more. Most tools process files locally in the browser. PDF Translator is an exception: the original PDF stays in the browser, while extracted text is sent to Bench's translation service and forwarded to DeepL.
capabilities: Image tools for resizing, cropping, compressing, converting, watermarking, stripping metadata and optimising SVG
Audio tools for converting, trimming, joining, normalising, loudness analysis, recording and applying effects
Create printable Avery label sheets and custom label layouts from CSV or pasted data
Build sticker sheets with print-ready PNG, PDF and SVG exports
Create cross-stitch, embroidery and diamond-painting patterns from photos
Check subtitle reading speed and repair subtitle line breaks
Split CSV columns and standardise dates in spreadsheet exports
Deduplicate contact lists and split or merge vCard files
Generate and clean QR codes, barcodes and SVG assets
Find duplicate photos and rank burst shots using local image analysis
Record, convert, trim, join and analyse audio in the browser
Translate PDF text through DeepL; extracted text leaves the browser for translation, while PDF pages stay local

seo.title: Progeni Bench — Browser Tools for Images, Audio, Files and Data
seo.description: Progeni Bench offers browser tools for images, audio, labels, CSV, subtitles and more. Most process files locally; PDF Translator sends extracted text to DeepL.

name: WaKit
shortDescription: Free client-side WhatsApp utilities: split 30-second status videos, open a chat without saving a number, generate QR and link codes, and compress audio to fit the 16 MB limit.
description: WaKit is a set of WhatsApp productivity tools that run entirely in the browser with WebAssembly. Split a long video into exact 30-second status clips with lossless FFmpeg stream copy, open a wa.me chat without adding a contact, generate WhatsApp chat links and QR codes, and transcode audio so it fits the 16 MB document limit. There is no upload endpoint: media is read from the file picker into browser memory and released when you clear the tool.
capabilities: Split videos into exact 30-second WhatsApp status clips with lossless stream copy
Open a WhatsApp chat from a phone number without saving it to contacts
Generate wa.me links and QR codes, including Wi-Fi and payment payloads
Compress audio to the 16 MB WhatsApp document limit with local FFmpeg transcoding

seo.title: WaKit — Private WhatsApp Status Splitter, Direct Chat, QR and Audio Tools
seo.description: Split WhatsApp status videos, message without saving numbers, generate QR codes and compress audio to 16 MB — in your browser, no uploads.

name: Progeni Atlas
shortDescription: Autonomous, enterprise-grade technical screening and live multi-modal interviewing platform
description: Progeni Atlas is a real-time conversational technical interview platform designed to simulate an authentic 1-on-1 interview with a Senior Technical Lead. Featuring low-latency neural speech, multi-modal proctoring, synchronized code execution, and rubric-driven candidate assessments.
capabilities: Low-latency neural speech synthesis
Multi-modal proctoring ( gaze and presence tracking )
Synchronized code execution environment
Rubric-driven candidate assessments
Real-time closed captions
Audio waveform visualizers

seo.title: Progeni Atlas — AI-Powered Technical Screening & Live Multi-Modal Interviewing
seo.description: Progeni Atlas is a real-time conversational technical interview platform with low-latency neural speech, multi-modal proctoring, and rubric-driven candidate assessments.
